conventions.C: C[i][j]=1 iff i precedes j; full strict transitive relation, not Hasse links
conventions.D: Sorted multiset of paired (past size, future size), with multiplicities
conventions.K: S A - A S = 2 (transpose(C) C - C transpose(C))
conventions.isomorphism: Order preserving; time reversal is a separate test, not an equivalence imposed on the data
conventions.polynomials: det(t I - operator), integer coefficients in descending order

hypothesis.next_acceptance: Enumerate all 2045 nonisomorphic seven-element posets, independently verify completeness, and test all F0 collision classes with both moments. Record every remaining pair; do not substitute full D for the scalar hypothesis.
hypothesis.statement: For any strict finite posets P,Q of equal cardinality n<=7 with time orientation retained, equality of (F0,W_future,W_past) implies order-preserving isomorphism.
hypothesis.universal_extension: Refuted at n=8 by the explicit connected degree-control pair.

literature.note: Paired incoming/outgoing degree sequence combined with spectra already reported complete through n=7. This work supplies explicit four-pair witnesses and tests its scalar compression; no novelty claim for D.

local_scope.n6: All 318 existing representatives, independently recalculate spectra and new observables; existing atlas verifier certifies enumeration
